name: Sneh Adhikari
heroTitle: Hi, I'm Sneh — a network engineer in Kathmandu.
heroLede: I work on firewalls, WAFs, DDoS protection and enterprise routing for government and commercial infrastructure. Currently at NextGen Solutions.
about: I’m a network engineer based in Kathmandu, working primarily with enterprise infrastructure and production environments. My work takes me from physical infrastructure — rack builds, cabling, and patch panels — to configuring and troubleshooting networks, firewalls, and security systems under real-world production conditions.

contactMessage: If you have a project, need a hand with firewalls or network infrastructure, or just want to talk — drop me a message.
